title: Is Carpet Outdated in 2026? Where It Still Wins
meta: Carpet is not outdated in 2026, it moved upstairs. Wills Flooring explains where carpet still beats hard floors in Kirkland homes and where it hurts resale.
keywords: is carpet outdated 2026, carpet vs hardwood bedrooms, is carpet coming back, wall to wall carpet 2026, carpet in bedrooms Kirkland

blocks.lead: Carpet is not outdated in 2026, but wall-to-wall carpet on a main floor is. It has moved upstairs, into bedrooms, bonus rooms, stairs and media rooms, where it still beats every hard floor on comfort, sound and warmth.
blocks.detail: Buyers in Kirkland expect hardwood or vinyl plank in living rooms, kitchens and hallways. The same buyers walk into a carpeted bedroom and feel relieved. The question is not whether carpet is dated, it is which rooms it belongs in.

blocks.html: A common Reddit thread asks whether putting carpet in a house makes it look like a 1990s rental. The honest answer from a company that installs both carpet and hardwood every week: it depends entirely on the room. We pull carpet out of Kirkland living rooms in Houghton and Rose Hill almost every month and replace it with hardwood or vinyl plank. We also install new carpet upstairs in those same houses on the same job. Both decisions are correct.

blocks.text: Why people think carpet is outdated

items.title: Open-plan main floors
items.text: Kitchens now flow into living rooms, and nobody wants a carpet edge six feet from a stove. Once the kitchen is hard floor, the living room follows. That is the real reason carpet left the main floor, not fashion.

items.title: Listing photos
items.text: Hardwood photographs well. Beige carpet photographs like beige carpet. Kirkland listings compete on photos, so sellers rip out main-floor carpet before listing and buyers learn to expect it.

items.title: Pets and allergies
items.text: Older cut-pile carpet held pet hair and dust. Modern low-pile and triexta carpets release it far better, but the reputation stuck. Vinyl plank arrived at the same time and took the pet-owner market.

items.title: Builder-grade memories
items.text: Most of what people remember as dated is thin polyester on a cheap pad, worn flat in the traffic lane after five years. Good carpet on a dense pad does not look like that at year ten.

blocks.text: What carpet does that hard floors cannot

items.html: Sound. A carpeted upstairs over a hardwood main floor is the quietest house layout there is. Vinyl plank with the best underlayment still transmits footfall that carpet on a pad simply absorbs. Anyone in a Kirkland townhome or Totem Lake condo with a neighbor below already knows this.

Warmth. Carpet and pad add measurable insulation over a crawlspace or a garage. On the plateau side of Bridle Trails, where many 1970s and 1980s homes have bedrooms over unheated garages, that is the difference between socks and no socks.
Falls. Stairs and toddlers, stairs and dogs, stairs and anyone over seventy. Carpet forgives what hardwood punishes.
Speed and disruption. A whole upstairs is usually carpeted in one day with no sanding, no cure time and no furniture in the garage for a week.
Easy resets. Replacing bedroom carpet before a sale is a one-day job. Refinishing a scratched hardwood bedroom is not.

blocks.text: When carpet is the wrong call, honestly

items.title: Main floor of a house you are selling
items.text: If the living room is carpeted and the kitchen is not, Kirkland buyers will price a floor replacement into their offer. Hardwood or vinyl plank on the main level pays for itself in most Eastside listings. Carpet upstairs does not need to change.

items.title: Any room with a water source
items.text: Kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms and mudrooms. A wet pad grows mold under a carpet that looks fine on top. Vinyl plank belongs here. See our guide to which rooms should have carpet.

items.title: Dogs with accidents
items.text: A puppy or a senior dog with a bladder problem will defeat any carpet eventually. Use it in the bedrooms the dog does not sleep in, and put a waterproof pad under any carpet the dog uses.

items.title: Below-grade rooms without a moisture plan
items.text: A Kirkland daylight basement can be carpeted, but only after a moisture test and with a pad that does not absorb water. Skipping that step is why basement carpet gets its reputation.

blocks.title: The mistake we see most:
blocks.text: Homeowners replace good bedroom carpet with vinyl plank because they read that carpet is dated, then live with cold floors and echo upstairs. If the carpet is under eight years old and not worn, keep it and spend the money on the main floor instead.
How to choose carpet that will not look dated in 2036

items.html: Pick a mid-tone neutral, not a trend color. Warm gray and oatmeal have been safe for a decade. Anything named after a food or a jewel will date.
Go lower and denser, not taller. Fold the sample back. If you see the backing easily, it will mat in the hallway.
Match the pad to the room. Firm and dense for stairs and halls, a little softer in bedrooms, moisture-barrier where pets sleep.
Stop carpet at the bedroom door, not the hallway. A hard-floor upstairs hall with carpeted bedrooms reads current. Carpet flowing down the hall reads 2004.

Look at samples in your own light. Kirkland bedrooms facing the lake get very different light from Rose Hill rooms facing the trees. We bring the samples to you so you can see them where they will live.

Get the whole plan in one quote. The best-looking houses we work on do carpet upstairs and hardwood or vinyl plank downstairs on one visit, with matching transitions. Ask for both on the same free estimate.

faq.q: Do buyers in Kirkland still accept carpet in bedrooms?
faq.a: Yes. Almost every Kirkland listing we prepare keeps or replaces bedroom carpet rather than converting to hard floors. Agents ask for main-floor hardwood or vinyl plank and fresh, neutral carpet upstairs. Buyers with young kids often prefer it.

faq.q: Is carpet coming back in style?
faq.a: In specific rooms, yes. Bedrooms, bonus rooms and media rooms are moving back toward carpet after a decade of hard floors everywhere, mainly because of noise and cold. Patterned and textured loops are also more popular than they have been since the 1990s.

Carpet on a main floor next to a hard-floor kitchen usually costs you at sale, because buyers assume they will replace it. Carpet in bedrooms and bonus rooms does not lower value if it is clean and neutral. Worn or stained carpet anywhere costs you more than replacing it.

faq.q: What carpet colors look current in 2026?
faq.a: Warm grays, greige, oatmeal, mushroom and soft taupe. Cooler grays are fading. Patterns are small and tone-on-tone rather than bold. Anything with a strong color cast, including the beige-pink of older builder carpet, reads dated.

faq.q: How long does modern carpet last?
faq.a: Eight to fifteen years depending on fiber, density and pad. Nylon and triexta on a dense pad in bedrooms can pass fifteen. Polyester in a hallway may look tired at six. The pad matters as much as the carpet.

faq.q: Should I carpet stairs in a house with hardwood downstairs?
faq.a: It is the most common Kirkland setup we install: hardwood main floor, carpeted stairs and bedrooms. A carpet runner over hardwood stairs is the other option. Either is safer and quieter than bare wood treads, especially with kids or dogs.
